summary: Independent backend and system-harness reviewers found blocking lifecycle reconciliation, transient consumer recovery, duplicate desired-state identity, secret-redaction, and replay-proof defects, plus contract validation and cleanup gaps. The candidate must return to code before formal testing.
validation: Backend reviewer inspected final origin/main...bb2625a delta against all eight feature requirements
System reviewer inspected only final tests/system delta for real-service fidelity, replay semantics, redaction, bounded waits, and cleanup
Review tree was clean and stable; reviewers performed no mutations
blockers: Lifecycle invalidation stales/blocks active heads but does not transactionally create a new pending desired state/build.
Transient non-HTTP infrastructure failures can escape and terminate the Knowledge consumer instead of bounded ordered retry/DLQ.
A distinct replay event ID for the same snapshot/generation can reference a new desired-state ID that was not inserted.
System child-process diagnostics retain raw output despite configured database, object-store, JWT, and workload secrets.
Replay proof uses a fixed two-second drain instead of a captured Kafka high-watermark boundary.
System Model path does not launch Model worker and reuses a GitHub fixture URL as the provider endpoint.
next_action: Route to code owners for focused backend and tests/system remediation, then rerun independent review on the corrected delta.

issues.title: Lifecycle invalidation never enqueues replacement generation
issues.details: InvalidateGenerationAsync marks publications stale and desired states blocked, while ClaimNextBuildAsync only claims pending states. Re-resolve the active head and transactionally enqueue the new desired state/build with a concurrency regression test.

issues.title: Transient infrastructure failures can terminate Knowledge consumer
issues.details: Retry classification covers HttpRequestException only. Classify bounded retryable database/object-store failures and route terminal outcomes through the existing ordered DLQ path without advancing later offsets.

issues.title: Distinct replay event can reference non-inserted desired-state ID
issues.details: IngestSnapshotAsync uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING for desired state but proceeds with a newly generated ID. Return/use the existing snapshot+generation desired-state ID and create at most one build; add replay coverage with a distinct CloudEvent ID.

issues.title: Source snapshot object/ref fields are incompletely validated
issues.details: Validate schema-required object format, commit/tree/ref metadata, and relevant cross-field consistency before persistence/materialization; retain nullable semantics only where producer schema permits them.

issues.title: Model workload endpoint omits documented 401 response
issues.details: Runtime returns 401 for missing/invalid HMAC proof while OpenAPI describes 403 only. Align the producer-owned contract with actual 401 authentication failure and retain 403 only for an implemented authorization denial.

issues.title: System proof omits real Model worker/provider fixture
issues.details: The harness starts Model API only and points configuration at a GitHub fixture that has no model endpoint. Start the real Model worker with production configuration and use a dedicated deterministic OpenAI-compatible fixture, or narrow the proof with explicit requirement evidence if worker/provider execution is not part of resolution.

issues.title: Replay proof relies on fixed drain duration
issues.details: GetPersistedBuildsAsync can miss delayed duplicate output or count retry-generated builds. Capture Kafka high-watermark after replay, drain to that boundary, and count only root queued events causally tied to the original Source event.

issues.title: Raw child-process diagnostics can retain secrets
issues.details: LocalDotNetProcess stores and returns raw stdout/stderr while child environments contain database passwords, S3 credentials, JWTs, and workload/model secrets. Redact known configured secret values before retaining bounded output and add a redaction test.

issues.title: Process and Kafka cleanup are not fully exception-safe
issues.details: Bound post-kill waits; ensure Subscribe failures dispose the newly built consumer; and dispose consumers in finally even if Close throws, recording close/dispose failures independently.

issues.title: Loopback port reservation has an address-reuse race
issues.details: Ports are released before migrations and API startup, so concurrent processes may claim them. Keep reservations through binding or implement bounded address-in-use retry with ownership-safe readiness verification.
